AI Security Platform
Trusted by the world’s leading enterprises
AI loves context. Context is runtime.
From 3-mins investigation of an incident to bottom-line vulnerability scores, Sweet Security answers anything cloud with our
AI-native agent and deep runtime context.
The ROI of AI
Sweet Security puts AI at the core of cloud defense with a purpose-built LLM that powers risk prioritization, detection, investigation, and remediation. Transparent reasoning and enriched runtime context cut false positives and speed response—replacing today’s patchwork with one end-to-end solution.
